# Start effect (once, flag COLDWAR_SVN_initialized): cores, start ladders, variables, dynamic modifiers, meters.
# Called from the country history and, as a fallback, from on_startup and on_monthly_SVN.
COLDWAR_SVN_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = SVN
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_initialized }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_initialized
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: COLDWAR_SVN_initialize"
		518 = { add_core_of = ROOT }
		519 = { add_core_of = ROOT }
		520 = { add_core_of = ROOT }
		521 = { add_core_of = ROOT }
		522 = { add_core_of = ROOT }
		523 = { add_core_of = ROOT }
		524 = { add_core_of = ROOT }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_rural_security = 62 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_american_commitment = 70 }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SVN_state_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SVN_economy_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SVN_armed_forces_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SVN_security_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SVN_society_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SVN_meter_modifier }
		COLDWAR_SVN_update_meter_modifier = yes
	}
}

# Input: COLDWAR_SVN_meter_change (signed). The only way to change the meter; clamped 0-100.
COLDWAR_SVN_change_rural_security = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_rural_security_change_tt
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_rural_security = COLDWAR_SVN_meter_change }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SVN_rural_security min = 0 max = 100 }
	hidden_effect = { COLDWAR_SVN_update_meter_modifier = yes }
}

# Input: COLDWAR_SVN_meter_change (signed). The only way to change the meter; clamped 0-100.
COLDWAR_SVN_change_american_commitment = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_american_commitment_change_tt
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_american_commitment = COLDWAR_SVN_meter_change }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SVN_american_commitment min = 0 max = 100 }
	hidden_effect = { COLDWAR_SVN_update_meter_modifier = yes }
}

# Recomputes COLDWAR_SVN_meter_modifier from both meters (monthly and after every change).
COLDWAR_SVN_update_meter_modifier = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_agriculture_tax_modifier = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_communism_drift = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_consumer_goods_factor = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_mdcw_cw_assistance_limit = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_productivity_growth_modifier = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_return_on_investment_modifier = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_stability_factor = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_tax_gain_multiplier_modifier = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_rural_security < 50 } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_agriculture_tax_modifier = -0.05 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_communism_drift = 0.02 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_rural_security < 35 } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_stability_factor = -0.05 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_american_commitment < 40 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_american_commitment < 20 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut = 0.75 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SVN_L1_0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_consumer_goods_factor = 0.08 }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_consumer_goods_factor = COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_mdcw_cw_assistance_limit = -0.50 }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_mdcw_cw_assistance_limit = COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SVN_L1_1 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_consumer_goods_factor = 0.06 }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_consumer_goods_factor = COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_mdcw_cw_assistance_limit = -0.40 }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_mdcw_cw_assistance_limit = COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_tax_gain_multiplier_modifier = -0.02 }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_tax_gain_multiplier_modifier = COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SVN_L1_2 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_consumer_goods_factor = 0.04 }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_consumer_goods_factor = COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_mdcw_cw_assistance_limit = -0.30 }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_mdcw_cw_assistance_limit = COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_tax_gain_multiplier_modifier = -0.02 }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_tax_gain_multiplier_modifier = COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_return_on_investment_modifier = -0.03 }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_return_on_investment_modifier = COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SVN_L1_3 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_consumer_goods_factor = 0.02 }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_consumer_goods_factor = COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_mdcw_cw_assistance_limit = -0.20 }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_mdcw_cw_assistance_limit = COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_tax_gain_multiplier_modifier = -0.02 }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_tax_gain_multiplier_modifier = COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_return_on_investment_modifier = -0.03 }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_return_on_investment_modifier = COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_productivity_growth_modifier = -0.03 }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_meter_productivity_growth_modifier = COLDWAR_SVN_usc_cut }
		}
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes }
}

# Monthly drift of the meters (on_monthly_SVN).
COLDWAR_SVN_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_initialized }
		if = {
			limit = { has_war_with = VIE }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_rural_security = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_american_commitment > 35 } }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_american_commitment = -0.50 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SVN_rural_security min = 0 max = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SVN_american_commitment min = 0 max = 100 }
		COLDWAR_SVN_update_meter_modifier = yes
		COLDWAR_SVN_restore_bound_spirits = yes
		COLDWAR_SVN_offer_reconcile = yes
	}
}

# Change of government: a new direction may be chosen; bound spirits return with their party.
# Called from on_ruling_party_change / on_government_change and after every power focus (a change between two
# parties of the same MD outlook does not fire the native hooks).
COLDWAR_SVN_sync_politics = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_initialized }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_direction_chosen
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_ballot_closed_term
		COLDWAR_SVN_restore_bound_spirits = yes
	}
}

# Bound spirits (cancel while their party is out of office) return when it governs again; also checked monthly.
COLDWAR_SVN_restore_bound_spirits = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_initialized }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_struggle_committees_earned
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_struggle_committees }
				OR = {
					neutrality_neutral_social_are_in_power = yes
					neutrality_neutral_autocracy_are_in_power = yes
				}
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_struggle_committees
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_supreme_military_committee_earned
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_supreme_military_committee }
				nationalist_right_wing_populists_are_in_power = yes
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_supreme_military_committee
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_the_democracy_party_earned
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_the_democracy_party }
				western_autocrats_are_in_power = yes
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_the_democracy_party
		}
	}
}

			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_weekly_part = 52 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_SVN_weekly_part }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_the_coexistence_treaty }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_weekly_part = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_weekly_part = 0.0003 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_weekly_part = 52 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_SVN_weekly_part }
		}
		add_to_variable = { additional_expenses_rate = COLDWAR_SVN_weekly_expense }
	}
}

# Partner countries: their own weekly share (of THEIR GDP) for every SVN agreement spirit they hold. Runs in the
# partner scope from its own weekly budget pass (00_money_system.txt, COLDWAR patch), never from South Vietnam.

		divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_weekly_part = 52 }

# ---- Bilateral offers (SVN scope only; the partner is addressed through events) ----
# Renewal from the agreements category: the same send as the focus.
COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_root_send = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = VIE }
		VIE = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SVN.101 days = 1 } }
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_root_open value = 1 days = 90 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_root_party = ruling_party }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_root_refused
		}
	}
}

# Monthly and after every answer: SVN spirit returns when the pair is clear again; the partner is asked by a
# hidden event in its own scope. Fees and grants are never charged again (_paid flags).
# Offer 1 (prg_root): SVN side comes into force only while the pair is active; fee, grants and extras exactly once.
COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_root_activate = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_root_active = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_the_guns_fall_silent } }
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_the_guns_fall_silent
	}
}
# Offer 2 (prg_e_auto): SVN side comes into force only while the pair is active; fee, grants and extras exactly once.
COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_e_auto_activate = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_e_auto_active = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_confederation_with_the_north } }
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_confederation_with_the_north
	}
}
# Offer 3 (prg_e_unite): SVN side comes into force only while the pair is active; fee, grants and extras exactly once.
COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_e_unite_activate = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_e_unite_active = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_reunification_commission } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_e_unite_paid } }
			hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_e_unite_paid }
			hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_vie_subject }
		}
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_reunification_commission
	}
}

# Offer 9 (for_a_cip): SVN side comes into force only while the pair is active; fee, grants and extras exactly once.

	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_active = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_renewed_import_credits } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_paid } }
			hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_paid }
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.002 } }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_SVN_idea_renewed_import_credits
		hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes } }
	}

					type = infrastructure
					level = 1
					instant_build = yes
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.0077 } }

				uses = 1
				category = CAT_helicopters
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.003 } }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}

		hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes } }

# ---- Power focuses: called after change_ruling_party_effect (which already ran set_leader for the new party) ----
COLDWAR_SVN_power_leader_cath = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } }
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: COLDWAR_SVN_power_leader_cath"
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 20 } }
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: COLDWAR_SVN_power_leader_ky"
		if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { is_ai = no } } USA = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SVN.701 days = 1 } } }
	}
}

		if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { is_ai = no } } USA = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SVN.700 days = 1 } } }
	}
}

# The Open Contest, The Lotus Slate in Every Province and the decision below: the native MD election system
# (set_elections_48_months: a vote every four years from now, the 1967 constitution's presidential term).
COLDWAR_SVN_elections_on = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_elections_on_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_elections_open
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_ballot_closed_term
		set_elections_48_months = yes
	}
}

# ---- Leaders (called from set_leader_SVN, the native per-tag provider) ----
# One counter per slot: COLDWAR_SVN_leader_<slot> = index of the incumbent. It advances only when the native
# retirement path calls set_leader (MDCW_HP_native_retirement = 1, no do_not_retire), i.e. on death or retirement.
# Slot 0: with the successor flag of Groom Khiem as Successor, Tran Thien Khiem follows Thieu before Tran Van Huong.
COLDWAR_SVN_1970_set_leader = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { MDCW_HP_native_retirement = 1 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = do_not_retire }
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_leader_0 = 1 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_leader_0 > 2 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_leader_0 = 0 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_leader_0 > 0 } } }
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "COLDWAR_SVN_leader_nguyen_van_thieu"
				desc = ""
				picture = "gfx/leaders/SVN/SVN_Coldwar_Nguyen_Van_Thieu.dds"
				ideology = Western_Autocracy
				traits = { }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_leader_0 = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_thieu_e2_flag }
				create_country_leader = {
					name = "COLDWAR_SVN_leader_tran_thien_khiem"
					desc = ""
					picture = "gfx/leaders/SVN/SVN_tran_thien_khiem.dds"
					ideology = Western_Autocracy
					traits = { }
				}
			}
			else = {
				create_country_leader = {
					name = "COLDWAR_SVN_leader_tran_van_huong"
					desc = ""
					picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/SVN_tran_van_huong.dds"
					ideology = Western_Autocracy
					traits = { }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_leader_0 = 2 } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_thieu_e2_flag }
				create_country_leader = {
					name = "COLDWAR_SVN_leader_tran_van_huong"
					desc = ""
					picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/SVN_tran_van_huong.dds"

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { MDCW_HP_native_retirement = 1 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = do_not_retire }
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_leader_1 = 1 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_leader_1 > 2 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_leader_1 = 0 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_leader_1 > 0 } } }
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "COLDWAR_SVN_leader_nguyen_gia_hien"
				desc = ""
				picture = "gfx/leaders/SVN/SVN_nguyen_gia_hien.dds"
				ideology = conservatism
				traits = { }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SVN_leader_1 = 1 } }
			create_country_leader = {
